Hi Alex — good question.
- latency_ms = end-to-end inference latency in milliseconds.
- processing_ms = server-side processing time (pre/post processing).

For the exercise: a batch replay is fine (single-threaded replay of the CSV). If you want to show concurrent results as an enhancement, include notes in README — it's optional.

If anything else comes up, ping me.

Thanks,
Mina
